newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Magna Prima debuts at 10.00 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Magna Prima debuts at 10.00 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian civil engineering firm Magna Prima Bhd made its debut on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday at 10.00 ringgit, against an offer price of 2.50 ringgit.
The company offered 2.55 million shares to the public, and is listed on the Second Board of the exchange.
Magna Prima is involved in civil engineering, infrastructure and building works, specialising in crushing services, quarry services and property development.

The company made a net profit of 6.87 million ringgit in the year to December 31, 1995, up 86 percent on the previous year. The gain was recorded on a turnover of 74.11 million ringgit, up 112 percent on the previous year.
Magna Prima estimates its net profit to increase to 8.84 million ringgit in the year to December 31, 1996, and forecasts the figure to increase to 13.08 million ringgit in 1997.
